behaviors.trigger: A pinned rule set and a stable snapshot both exist and the package's frontmatter is inspected.
inputs: The supported Claude Code frontmatter field table
behaviors.completion: Exactly one required AV-F04 row records the optional-frontmatter outcome for the entrypoint; each recorded source divergence appears as its own non-required row with a distinct check identity; and a package whose entrypoint metadata failed to parse carries the failure once, on AV-F01, with AV-F04 justified NOT_APPLICABLE.
prerequisites: The entrypoint is parsed once per package observation
behaviors.failure: A divergence or a duplicated parse failure changes the required reduction.
behaviors.recovery: A divergence is never required and never alters the reduction; a parse failure is carried once by AV-F01 and AV-F04 is justified NOT_APPLICABLE.

resources.purpose: Emits the AV-F04 optional-frontmatter rows and the separate non-required divergence rows.
resources.load_when: When running text and resource observations over a captured package.

helper_contract.outputs: Check rows, resource-graph edges, reachability and context measurements. AV-F04 carries one required row per entrypoint plus zero or more non-required divergence rows.
helper_contract.runtime: Python 3.10+ standard library; PyYAML for YAML-parsing paths. Checked, never installed.
helper_contract.errors: An entrypoint parse failure is reported once on AV-F01; AV-F04 is then NOT_APPLICABLE with a reason. A missing parser is NOT_RUN.
helper_contract.reuse_reason: The reduction contract is shared by every package assessment and must not differ per run.

resources.purpose: Structural observations, including the non-required advisory divergence rows.
resources.load_when: When running structural observations over a captured package.

helper_contract.inputs: structure --source <dir>, plus the other documented subcommands.
helper_contract.outputs: JSON observation objects; advisory divergence rows are non-required.
helper_contract.runtime: Python 3.10+ standard library; PyYAML for YAML-parsing paths. Checked, never installed.
helper_contract.errors: Non-zero exit on required mismatch or excluded boundary; a recorded divergence is never a required mismatch.
helper_contract.reuse_reason: reduce_checks is the single shared reduction; advisory rows must stay outside it.

resources.purpose: The supported field table and the recorded source divergences the rows cite.
resources.load_when: When checking a target's frontmatter or classifying an unknown optional field.

adverse_conditions.condition: An inspected Claude Code package declares allowed-tools as a YAML list.
adverse_conditions.expected_observation: The required AV-F04 row is PASS and the AV-F04 reduction is PASS; the portability divergence appears only as a non-required row.

adverse_conditions.condition: An inspected package declares a malformed optional field such as effort: ultra.
adverse_conditions.expected_observation: Exactly one required FAIL row is emitted for the entrypoint, on AV-F01; AV-F04 is NOT_APPLICABLE with a reason.

adverse_conditions.condition: A package declares several recorded divergences at once.
adverse_conditions.expected_observation: Each divergence produces its own row with a distinct check identity; none collides with another and none is required.
